title: Compact Vision-Language Models for Cross-Crop Plant-Disease Diagnosis at the Edge: A CPU-Only Study - code, descriptor registries and results
description:
Code, descriptor registries and result files for a study of what lets a small, frozen vision-language model diagnose crops it was never trained on. Seven ways of authoring the class descriptions are compared across nested held-out sets of 16, 34 and 51 unseen classes on four compact contrastive encoders, alongside a CPU latency and INT8 benchmark.

The deposit contains the descriptor registries for every authoring strategy, the DCLIP+ and CuPL+ prompts with their raw replies, every result file the manuscript reads, the per-architecture results of the 14 supervised baselines, the weight-space interpolation sweep, the table and figure generators, the full experimental code, and the manuscript. It reproduces every number and figure in the article from the released result files.

The images are not redistributed here: they are the SAGE crop-disease dataset at revision bc9bd2899f, released separately under the MIT licence. scripts/config.py pins that revision.

MANIFEST.sha256 lists every file with its SHA-256 digest.
